# Anbennar Overhaul: values for the county view's dig progress bar (gui/window_county_view.gui, generated by
# tools/build_county_view_override.py). Province scope, a dwarven hold.

# Share of the level's months already dug, 0-100; 0 without a running dig.
aov_dig_percent = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { aov_hold_dig_running = yes }
		value = var:aov_dig_progress
		multiply = 100
		divide = aov_dig_months
		max = 100
	}
}

# Years the dig still needs at the quarterly pace (dig events can move it), rounded up; 0 without a running dig.
aov_dig_years_left = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { aov_hold_dig_running = yes }
		value = aov_dig_months
		subtract = var:aov_dig_progress
		divide = 12
		ceiling = yes
		min = 0
	}
}
